test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

It seems that these walls __have not been painted since years.__

options.text: have not been paint since years.
have not being painted for years.
have not been painted for years.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'since years' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be 'for years' to indicate a **duration of time.**
 
• The correct form of the sentence should use the past participle 'painted' along with the correct preposition 'for'.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase is 'have not been painted for years'.

Hence, the correct statement is '*It seems that these walls have not been painted** for** years*.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The preposition 'since' is used to indicate** a point in time** when an action began, whereas 'for' is used to** indicate a duration of time.**
 
• Example with 'since': *I have lived here **since 2010***.
 
• Example with 'for': *I have lived here **for 10 years***
